description: Call this tool for the ECB rate of one currency pair across a window. Returns one row per published day plus the min, max, average and the change. A window wider than the free 90 days is shortened, not refused.

days.description: Trailing window in calendar days, default 30. Only TARGET business days carry a rate, so 30 days holds about 21 rows. Free reads up to 90 days back; Pro reads the whole series back to 1999-01-04

from_date.description: ISO date, inclusive. Overrides days. Free is limited to the last 90 days

max_rows.description: Cap the table, default 200. min/max/avg still cover the whole window

to.description: Quote currency of the pair. Each row is 1 from = X to

name: rate_history
title: Rate history for a pair
